why.title: Experienced specialists
why.text: Doctors across every department, with time set aside to listen before they treat.

why.title: Clear communication
why.text: You are told what is happening, what it costs, and what comes next.

why.title: Care that continues
why.text: From first consultation to recovery, your records and follow-ups stay in one place.

faq.q: How do I book an appointment?
faq.a: Use the booking page or the quick booking strip on the homepage. Our team confirms by phone.
Each doctor’s consultation fee is shown on their card.

faq.q: How do I reach you in an emergency?

cta.title: Need to see a doctor?
cta.text: Send an appointment request and our team will confirm by phone.

pages.dep_s: Choose a department to request an appointment.
pages.con_s: Fill in the form and send it by email or WhatsApp. We will call to confirm your time.
